rows.text: The Income-tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026 (No. 2 of 2026), dated New Delhi 5 June 2026, is promulgated by the President, Droupadi Murmu, under article 123(1) because Parliament is not in session, and is signed 'DROUPADI MURMU, President'.
